title: Protopic Adherence and Efficacy in Korean Eczema Patient
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether the dosage of 0.1% tacrolimus ointment applied on unit area of eczema influence the efficacy of treatment.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* at least 19 years of age with a diagnosis of atopic dermatitis
* treated with protopic 0.1% ointment

Exclusion Criteria:

* treated with other medication or topical agent
* skin lesion on the scalp or hand and foot
* pregnant women/lactating women
